# FrontEndFusion

> An open-source learning hub for HTML5, CSS3, responsive design, and modern frontend techniques — with interactive demos, copy-paste snippets, and in-depth guides.

FrontEndFusion is a structured, static learning resource for frontend developers. All content is server-rendered/static HTML, so it is fully readable by AI crawlers and LLMs. Topics include HTML basics, CSS fundamentals, responsive design, advanced CSS, best practices, accessibility, SEO, JavaScript basics, and a CSS cheat sheet.

## Key pages
- Home: https://frontendfusion.vercel.app/
- Projects (interactive demos): https://frontendfusion.vercel.app/projects
- Code Snippets (copy-paste forms): https://frontendfusion.vercel.app/snippets
- Guides (docs): https://frontendfusion.vercel.app/docs
- Resources: https://frontendfusion.vercel.app/resources
- Learning Path: https://frontendfusion.vercel.app/learning
- Book Library: https://frontendfusion.vercel.app/library
